title: Inbox
description: Messages & comments across all platforms. The MessageAgent suggests replies — only what you approve is sent, directly via the platform (comment reply or direct message). Connect platforms under Social Media and fetch new messages with “Fetch messages”.
emptyState: No conversations yet — fetch messages from your connected platforms or create one manually.

newConversation.simulateHint: Add a conversation manually. With a platform ID (comment ID or recipient ID) you can reply for real; without an ID it only serves to test the reply draft.
newConversation.externalIdPlaceholder: Platform ID (comment ID / LinkedIn comment URN / recipient ID, optional)

detail.openDraftExists: There's already an open draft above — edit or send it first.
detail.simulateMoreHint: Add another incoming message manually (e.g. for testing):
detail.noExternalId: Without a platform ID nothing can actually be sent.
detail.websiteHint: Message from the website widget. Approved replies appear in the visitor's widget and, if configured, are sent to your webhook (e.g. for an email notification).

sync.noAccounts: No platform connected — connect accounts under Social Media.
